BiblicalUsage: The word is mighty, strong, powerful. Daniel says the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron, breaking in pieces and bruising; the kingdom of the Most High is an everlasting kingdom; and the fourth beast was dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly, with great iron teeth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the strong kingdoms of this world break and bruise, but the Most High's kingdom is the strong one that lasts.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
